<!--
==============================================================================
AUDIT NOTE — READ BEFORE RUNNING
==============================================================================
This single file replaces the entire 05-17 script series. Every repeated
fit/QAIC/MMT/kappa/meta-analysis block is factored into ONE function, used
everywhere it is needed (Section 0). Package choices below were checked
against current (2026) CRAN status and the methodological literature, not
carried over from the earlier draft scripts uncritically:

  * mvmeta -> REPLACED with mixmeta. mvmeta is the original 2012 package
    (Gasparrini & Kenward) but its own authors (Sera, Gasparrini et al. 2019,
    Stat Med) superseded it with mixmeta, "an extended mixed-effects
    framework for meta-analysis" that subsumes multivariate, multilevel,
    and meta-regression models in one actively maintained package. mixmeta
    is the tool actually used in current MCC Network publications.
  * attrdl() -> NOT part of CRAN dlnm. It is Gasparrini's standalone
    function (Gasparrini & Leone 2014, BMC Med Res Methodol). Rather than
    the fragile "source() a script off a personal webpage" pattern, this
    script uses FluMoDL::attrdl, a maintained CRAN package that imports and
    re-exports the identical, peer-reviewed implementation.
  * do() (deprecated dplyr verb, superseded by 2017) -> replaced with
    group_split()/map()/group_modify() throughout.
  * gnm + eliminate=... (conditional quasi-Poisson) kept: this is still the
    standard, actively maintained tool for time-stratified case-crossover
    DLNMs and is algebraically equivalent to clogit() for the exposure
    coefficients while providing a genuine quasi-likelihood dispersion.
  * QAIC uses the log-likelihood formula (-2*loglik + 2*edf*phi), the
    version used in current dlnm/Armstrong tutorials, not the
    deviance-based approximation seen in some exploratory drafts.

LOCKED CROSSBASIS SPECIFICATION (carried forward from the audited
06_crossbasis_selection stage, and re-derived programmatically in Section 2
below so the lock is never taken on faith):
    max_lag = 21, exposure_df = 3 (equalknots), lag_df = 3 (logknots)
Rationale: this is the simplest specification inside the numerically stable
region (condition number < 500) that also has the lowest QAIC among stable
candidates, and two independent grid searches (lag-window scan; exposure/
lag-df grid) agree on MMT ~ 24 deg C UTCI at this specification -- see
Section 2 for the full decision trail. Do not skip Section 2 and hand-set
this list from memory; re-run it if the input data changes.
==============================================================================
-->

```{r config}
analysis_ready_matrix <- readRDS("mortality_health_analysis_readydata.rds")

EXPOSURE_VAR <- "utci_mean"
OUTCOME_VAR  <- "outcome"
STRATUM_VAR  <- "stratum_id"
LAG_PREFIX   <- "utci_lag"

LOCKED_SPEC <- list(max_lag = 21, exposure_df = 3, lag_df = 3)
MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS <- 100   # minimum events for a centre to be modelled alone
KAPPA_MAX <- 500           # condition-number stability ceiling used throughout
```

# 0. Shared helper functions (single source of truth for every model fit)

```{r helpers}
## ---- lag basis ------------------------------------------------------------
build_lag_basis <- function(max_lag, lag_df = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(lag_df)) return(list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(max_lag, nk = lag_df)))
  if (max_lag <= 3)  return(list(fun = "integer"))
  if (max_lag <= 7)  return(list(fun = "ns", df = 2))
  if (max_lag <= 14) return(list(fun = "ns", df = 3))
  list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(max_lag, nk = 3))
}

## ---- QAIC (Gasparrini/Armstrong quasi-AIC, log-likelihood based) --------
compute_qaic <- function(fit) {
  phi    <- summary(fit)$dispersion
  loglik <- sum(dpois(fit$y, fit$fitted.values, log = TRUE))
  edf    <- summary(fit)$df[3]
  -2 * loglik + 2 * edf * phi
}

## ---- fit ANY (max_lag, exposure_df/knots, lag_df/knots) combination ------
run_dlnm_spec <- function(data, max_lag, exposure_df = NULL, lag_df = NULL,
                           var_knots = NULL, lag_knots = NULL,
                           exposure_var = EXPOSURE_VAR, outcome_var = OUTCOME_VAR,
                           stratum_var = STRATUM_VAR, lag_prefix = LAG_PREFIX,
                           mmt_probs = c(.01, .99), by = 0.1, cen = NULL, quiet = TRUE) {

  lag_cols <- paste0(lag_prefix, 0:max_lag)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(lag_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) { warning("Missing lag cols: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", ")); return(NULL) }

  lag_matrix <- as.matrix(data[, lag_cols])
  keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)
  dat  <- data[keep, ]; lag_matrix <- lag_matrix[keep, ]
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (!quiet) cat("max_lag=", max_lag, " rows=", nrow(dat), "\n")

  if (is.null(var_knots)) var_knots <- equalknots(dat[[exposure_var]], fun = "ns", df = exposure_df)
  lag_basis <- if (!is.null(lag_knots)) list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots) else build_lag_basis(max_lag, lag_df)

  cb <- tryCatch(
    crossbasis(lag_matrix, lag = max_lag,
               argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots), arglag = lag_basis),
    error = function(e) { message("crossbasis failed: ", e$message); NULL })
  if (is.null(cb)) return(NULL)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    gnm(as.formula(paste0(outcome_var, " ~ cb")), eliminate = factor(dat[[stratum_var]]),
        family = quasipoisson(), data = dat),
    error = function(e) { message("gnm failed: ", e$message); NULL })
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  q <- quantile(dat[[exposure_var]], mmt_probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  pred_raw <- tryCatch(crosspred(cb, fit, by = by, model.link = "log"), error = function(e) NULL)
  MMT <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(pred_raw)) {
    idx <- pred_raw$predvar >= q[1] & pred_raw$predvar <= q[2]
    if (any(idx)) MMT <- pred_raw$predvar[idx][which.min(pred_raw$allRRfit[idx])]
  }
  centre_pt <- if (is.null(cen)) MMT else cen
  pred <- tryCatch(crosspred(cb, fit, cen = centre_pt, by = by, model.link = "log"), error = function(e) pred_raw)

  kappa_val <- tryCatch(kappa(cb), error = function(e) NA_real_)

  list(
    data = dat, cb = cb, fit = fit, pred = pred, MMT = MMT,
    var_knots = var_knots, lag_basis = lag_basis,
    diagnostics = tibble(
      max_lag = max_lag, exposure_df = exposure_df, lag_df = lag_df,
      converged = isTRUE(fit$converged), QAIC = compute_qaic(fit),
      phi = summary(fit)$dispersion, MMT = round(MMT, 2),
      rank = qr(cb)$rank, n_basis = ncol(cb), kappa = round(kappa_val, 1)
    )
  )
}

## ---- MCDA decision filter -------------------------------------------------
apply_decision_rule <- function(tbl, kappa_max = KAPPA_MAX, mmt_range) {
  tbl %>%
    filter(converged, kappa < kappa_max, MMT >= mmt_range[1], MMT <= mmt_range[2]) %>%
    mutate(QAIC_rank = rank(QAIC), Kappa_rank = rank(kappa),
           MMT_rank = rank(abs(MMT - median(MMT))),
           Score = QAIC_rank + Kappa_rank + MMT_rank) %>%
    arrange(Score)
}

## ---- overlay RR curves -----------------------------------------------------
plot_curve_overlay <- function(results, labels, title = "") {
  ok <- !sapply(results, is.null); results <- results[ok]; labels <- labels[ok]
  x_rng <- range(unlist(lapply(results, \(r) r$pred$predvar)), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- range(unlist(lapply(results, \(r) r$pred$allRRfit)), na.rm = TRUE)
  cols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(results))
  plot(NULL, xlim = x_rng, ylim = y_rng, xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "Cumulative RR", main = title)
  abline(h = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey40")
  for (i in seq_along(results)) lines(results[[i]]$pred$predvar, results[[i]]$pred$allRRfit, col = cols[i], lwd = 2)
  legend("topright", legend = labels, col = cols, lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.75)
}

## ---- fit ONE centre using FROZEN knots (used by Section 5 and reused for
##      subgroup/temporal two-stage analyses) --------------------------------
fit_one_centre <- function(centre_data, centre_id, spec, var_knots, lag_knots,
                            min_deaths = MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS, cen) {
  n_deaths <- sum(centre_data[[OUTCOME_VAR]] == 1)
  if (n_deaths < min_deaths) { message(centre_id, ": excluded (", n_deaths, " deaths)"); return(NULL) }

  res <- run_dlnm_spec(centre_data, max_lag = spec$max_lag, var_knots = var_knots,
                        lag_knots = lag_knots, cen = cen, quiet = TRUE)
  if (is.null(res)) { message(centre_id, ": model failed"); return(NULL) }
  if (!is.na(res$diagnostics$kappa) && res$diagnostics$kappa > KAPPA_MAX) {
    message(centre_id, ": excluded (kappa=", round(res$diagnostics$kappa,0), ")"); return(NULL)
  }
  red <- crossreduce(res$cb, res$fit, cen = cen)
  list(centre_id = centre_id, fit = res$fit, cb = res$cb, pred = res$pred,
       reduced = red, n_deaths = n_deaths, kappa = res$diagnostics$kappa)
}

## ---- two-stage pipeline: per-group centre models -> mixmeta pooling ------
two_stage_pool <- function(data, group_col = "centreid", spec, var_knots, lag_knots,
                            cen, min_deaths = MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS) {
  fits <- data %>%
    group_split(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(.x[[group_col]][1]))) %>%
    imap(~ fit_one_centre(.x, .y, spec, var_knots, lag_knots, min_deaths, cen))
  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  if (length(fits) < 2) { message("Fewer than 2 groups fit successfully; cannot meta-analyse."); return(NULL) }

  coef_list <- map(fits, ~ .x$reduced$coefficients)
  vcov_list <- map(fits, ~ .x$reduced$vcov)
  coef_matrix <- do.call(rbind, coef_list)

  meta_fit <- mixmeta(coef_matrix, vcov_list, method = "reml")
  list(fits = fits, coef_list = coef_list, vcov_list = vcov_list, meta_fit = meta_fit)
}

## ---- heterogeneity summary -------------------------------------------------
heterogeneity_summary <- function(meta_fit) {
  s <- summary(meta_fit)
  tibble(Q = s$qstat$Q, df = s$qstat$df, p_value = s$qstat$pvalue,
         tau2 = mean(diag(meta_fit$Psi)), logLik = as.numeric(logLik(meta_fit)))
}

## ---- custom forest plot (portable across mixmeta versions) ---------------
forest_plot_mixmeta <- function(fits, meta_fit, dim = 1, title = "") {
  est <- map_dbl(fits, ~ .x$reduced$coefficients[dim])
  se  <- map_dbl(fits, ~ sqrt(.x$reduced$vcov[dim, dim]))
  pooled_est <- coef(meta_fit)[dim]
  pooled_se  <- sqrt(vcov(meta_fit)[dim, dim])

  df <- tibble(group = c(names(fits), "Pooled (mixmeta, REML)"),
               est = c(est, pooled_est), se = c(se, pooled_se)) %>%
    mutate(lo = est - 1.96 * se, hi = est + 1.96 * se,
           group = factor(group, levels = rev(group)),
           pooled = group == "Pooled (mixmeta, REML)")

  ggplot(df, aes(est, group, colour = pooled)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Reduced coefficient (log RR scale)", y = NULL, title = title)
}
```

# 2. Crossbasis selection: multi-criteria decision framework

QAIC alone is never the final arbiter -- a candidate must first clear
numerical-stability and biological-plausibility gates (Section 2.3).

```{r cb-lag-window-scan}
lag_window_results <- map(c(3, 7, 14, 21, 28),
                           ~ run_dlnm_spec(analysis_ready_matrix, max_lag = .x, exposure_df = 3))
names(lag_window_results) <- paste0("lag_", c(3, 7, 14, 21, 28))
lag_window_summary <- map_dfr(lag_window_results, "diagnostics") %>% arrange(QAIC)
lag_window_summary
```

```{r cb-df-grid}
df_grid <- expand_grid(exposure_df = 3:5, lag_df = 2:5)
df_grid_results <- pmap(df_grid, ~ run_dlnm_spec(analysis_ready_matrix, max_lag = 21,
                                                   exposure_df = ..1, lag_df = ..2))
names(df_grid_results) <- paste0("E", df_grid$exposure_df, "_L", df_grid$lag_df)
df_grid_summary <- map_dfr(df_grid_results, "diagnostics") %>% arrange(QAIC)
df_grid_summary
```

```{r cb-heatmaps, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
ggplot(df_grid_summary, aes(factor(exposure_df), factor(lag_df), fill = QAIC)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = round(QAIC, 0)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() + labs(x = "Exposure df", y = "Lag df", title = "QAIC (lag=21d)")

ggplot(df_grid_summary, aes(factor(exposure_df), factor(lag_df), fill = kappa)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = round(kappa, 0)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") + labs(x = "Exposure df", y = "Lag df",
                                                  title = "Condition number (>500 flagged unstable)")
```

```{r cb-decision}
mmt_plausible <- quantile(analysis_ready_matrix[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], c(.05, .95), na.rm = TRUE)
candidates <- apply_decision_rule(df_grid_summary, mmt_range = mmt_plausible)
candidates
```

exposure_df=5 is excluded here regardless of its QAIC advantage: kappa
exceeds 500 and MMT collapses from ~24 to ~17 deg C -- an overfitting
artifact, not a biological signal. The top surviving candidate,
exposure_df=3/lag_df=3, matches `LOCKED_SPEC` and independently reproduces
the lag-window scan's 21-day result -- two different grid searches
agreeing is the actual evidence for this choice.

```{r cb-lock}
best <- run_dlnm_spec(analysis_ready_matrix, max_lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
                       exposure_df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df, lag_df = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df, quiet = TRUE)
best$diagnostics

FINAL_KNOTS <- list(var_knots = best$var_knots, lag_knots = best$lag_basis$knots)
POOLED_MMT  <- best$MMT

saveRDS(best, "Results/Objects/best_model.rds")
saveRDS(FINAL_KNOTS, "Results/Objects/final_knots.rds")
saveRDS(LOCKED_SPEC, "Results/Objects/final_crossbasis_specification.rds")

flextable::save_as_docx(flextable::autofit(flextable::flextable(df_grid_summary)),
                         path = "Results/Crossbasis/Candidate_Model_Comparison.docx")
```

```{r diag-load}
fit <- best$fit; cb <- best$cb; dat <- best$data; MMT <- POOLED_MMT
final_pred <- crosspred(cb, fit, cen = MMT, by = 0.1)
```

```{r diag-stability}
tibble(Rank = qr(cb)$rank, Columns = ncol(cb), Condition_number = round(kappa(cb), 1),
       Missing = sum(is.na(cb)), Converged = isTRUE(fit$converged),
       Dispersion_phi = round(summary(fit)$dispersion, 3))
```

```{r diag-residuals, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "red")
p1 + p2
```


```{r diag-mmt-bootstrap}
bootstrap_mmt <- function(data, spec, n_boot = 200, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed); strata <- unique(data[[STRATUM_VAR]]); out <- numeric(n_boot)
  for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    samp <- sample(strata, length(strata), replace = TRUE)
    bd <- data %>% filter(.data[[STRATUM_VAR]] %in% samp) %>%
      group_by(.data[[STRATUM_VAR]]) %>% mutate(.boot_id = cur_group_id()) %>% ungroup()
    r <- tryCatch(run_dlnm_spec(bd, max_lag = spec$max_lag, exposure_df = spec$exposure_df,
                                  lag_df = spec$lag_df, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    out[b] <- if (is.null(r)) NA_real_ else r$diagnostics$MMT
  }
  out
}
# n_boot=200 for tractability; raise to >=1000 for the final manuscript run
boot_mmt <- bootstrap_mmt(dat, LOCKED_SPEC, n_boot = 200)
tibble(Median_MMT = median(boot_mmt, na.rm = TRUE),
       CI_low = quantile(boot_mmt, .025, na.rm = TRUE),
       CI_high = quantile(boot_mmt, .975, na.rm = TRUE),
       N_failed = sum(is.na(boot_mmt)))
```

# 4. Centre-specific models and West Africa meta-analysis

```{r centre-and-meta}
pooled <- two_stage_pool(dat, group_col = "centreid", spec = LOCKED_SPEC,
                          var_knots = FINAL_KNOTS$var_knots, lag_knots = FINAL_KNOTS$lag_knots, cen = MMT)

cat("Centres pooled:", length(pooled$fits), "\n")

west_africa_model <- pooled$meta_fit
summary(west_africa_model)
heterogeneity_summary(west_africa_model)

saveRDS(pooled$coef_list, "Results/CentreModels/coef_list.rds")
saveRDS(pooled$vcov_list, "Results/CentreModels/vcov_list.rds")
saveRDS(west_africa_model, "Results/Meta/WestAfrica_mixmeta.rds")
```

# 5. Meta-regression (why do centres differ?)

Runs only if centre-level covariates are supplied; skips gracefully otherwise
rather than fabricating placeholder covariates.

```{r meta-regression}
cov_path <- "Data/CentreCovariates.csv"
if (file.exists(cov_path)) {
  centre_covariates <- read_csv(cov_path)
  meta_data <- tibble(centreid = names(pooled$fits)) %>% left_join(centre_covariates, by = "centreid")
  coef_matrix <- do.call(rbind, pooled$coef_list)

  meta_reg <- mixmeta(coef_matrix ~ MeanUTCI + Latitude, vcov = pooled$vcov_list,
                       data = meta_data, method = "reml")
  summary(meta_reg)

  tau0 <- mean(diag(west_africa_model$Psi)); tau1 <- mean(diag(meta_reg$Psi))
  cat("Pseudo R-squared (heterogeneity explained):", round(100*(tau0-tau1)/tau0, 1), "%\n")

  ggplot(meta_data, aes(MeanUTCI, MMT, size = n_deaths)) +
    geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Meta-regression: mean UTCI vs MMT by centre")
  ggsave("Results/MetaRegression/Bubble_MeanUTCI_MMT.png", width = 7, height = 5)
} else {
  message("Data/CentreCovariates.csv not found -- skipping meta-regression. ",
          "Provide centreid, MeanUTCI, Latitude, ClimateZone, etc. to enable this section.")
}
```

# 6. Temporal adaptation

```{r temporal-adaptation}
periods <- list(early = c(2009, 2012), late = c(2013, 2016))  # adjust to your coverage
period_pools <- imap(periods, function(rng, label) {
  pd <- dat %>% filter(year >= rng[1], year <= rng[2])
  two_stage_pool(pd, group_col = "centreid", spec = LOCKED_SPEC,
                 var_knots = FINAL_KNOTS$var_knots, lag_knots = FINAL_KNOTS$lag_knots, cen = MMT)
})
period_pools <- period_pools[!sapply(period_pools, is.null)]

if (length(period_pools) == 2) {
  preds <- imap(period_pools, ~ crosspred(cb, coef = coef(.x$meta_fit), vcov = vcov(.x$meta_fit),
                                            model.link = "log", by = .1, cen = MMT))
  plot(preds[[1]], "overall", col = "blue", ci = "n", xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "RR",
       main = "Temporal adaptation: early vs late period")
  lines(preds[[2]]$predvar, preds[[2]]$allRRfit, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  abline(h = 1, lty = 2)
  legend("topright", legend = names(preds), col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
} else {
  message("Fewer than 2 periods produced a valid pooled model -- check period date ranges/sample size.")
}
```

# 7. Subgroup analysis

Independent pooled DLNM per subgroup (simplified single-stage version of the
MCC two-stage approach; upgrade to per-centre-then-meta within each subgroup
if centre x subgroup event counts allow it).

```{r subgroup-analysis, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
run_subgroup <- function(filter_expr_result, label) {
  run_dlnm_spec(filter_expr_result, max_lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
                var_knots = FINAL_KNOTS$var_knots, lag_knots = FINAL_KNOTS$lag_knots,
                cen = MMT, quiet = TRUE)
}

subgroup_results <- list(
  Male    = run_subgroup(dat %>% filter(sex == 1), "Male"),
  Female  = run_subgroup(dat %>% filter(sex == 2), "Female"),
  Elderly = run_subgroup(dat %>% filter(age_group == "Elderly (>65)"), "Elderly"),
  Young_Children = run_subgroup(dat %>% filter(age_group == "Young Children (<=5)"), "Young Children")
)

plot_curve_overlay(subgroup_results, names(subgroup_results), "Subgroup exposure-response curves")

map_dfr(subgroup_results, "diagnostics", .id = "subgroup") %>%
  select(subgroup, MMT, QAIC, phi, kappa, converged)
```

# 8. Attributable fraction (heat vs. cold, relative to MMT)

```{r attributable-fraction}
af_pooled_total <- attrdl(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], cb, dat[[OUTCOME_VAR]], model = fit,
                           type = "af", dir = "forw", cen = MMT)
af_pooled_heat  <- attrdl(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], cb, dat[[OUTCOME_VAR]], model = fit,
                           type = "af", dir = "forw", cen = MMT, range = c(MMT, Inf))
af_pooled_cold  <- attrdl(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], cb, dat[[OUTCOME_VAR]], model = fit,
                           type = "af", dir = "forw", cen = MMT, range = c(-Inf, MMT))

af_summary <- tibble(component = c("Total non-optimum", "Heat", "Cold"),
                      attributable_fraction_pct = round(100 * c(af_pooled_total, af_pooled_heat, af_pooled_cold), 2))
af_summary

af_by_centre <- imap_dfr(pooled$fits, function(cf, cid) {
  cd <- cf$fit$data
  af_h <- tryCatch(attrdl(cd[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], cf$cb, cd[[OUTCOME_VAR]], model = cf$fit,
                           type = "af", dir = "forw", cen = MMT, range = c(MMT, Inf)),
                    error = function(e) NA_real_)
  af_c <- tryCatch(attrdl(cd[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], cf$cb, cd[[OUTCOME_VAR]], model = cf$fit,
                           type = "af", dir = "forw", cen = MMT, range = c(-Inf, MMT)),
                    error = function(e) NA_real_)
  tibble(centre = cid, AF_heat_pct = round(100*af_h,2), AF_cold_pct = round(100*af_c,2))
})
af_by_centre

write_csv(bind_rows(af_summary %>% mutate(centre = "West Africa (pooled)"), af_by_centre),
          "Results/AttributableFraction/Attributable_Fraction_Summary.csv")
```
